summary: @aaranged Yes my apologies. I was using semantic as the word in a POSH sense and not the loaded term for the work around standards. I do wonder if there are probably more actual use cases and consumers of microformats for personal sites.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@aaranged Yes my apologies. I was using semantic as the word in a POSH sense and not the loaded term for the work around standards.

I do wonder if there are probably more actual use cases and consumers of microformats for personal sites.
